status: Frozen before this continued heading assay; implementation and native-context collection follow checkpoint availability
training_schedule: After goal discovery:15 visible updates followed by an integer-uniform30–60-update blackout, repeating; actual hits restart15 visible updates and episode endings clear the schedule. One decision is1/15 second. Native goal/current codes remain available.

context_collection.source: Actual continued-policy rollouts using the final training blackout schedule and continued weights; never reuse original-network recurrent states
context_collection.selection: First two eligible complete15-update visible intervals ending at a scheduled blackout onset, from distinct environment slots, in chronological order. Goal must be known and unchanged; no new hit or episode reset inside the visible interval; starting position outside the goal disk by at least0.01m. Save actual recurrent state before the interval, goal code, position, last movement direction, room layout and prior action/reward. Retain rejected-interval counts.

diagnostic_family.physics: Use the original renderer/maps/CNN/LSTM. Share the actual native starting state, goal code, position, room and last movement direction; vary initial body heading only. Set translational and rotational motor noise, image noise and initial velocities to zero. Apply the same actual pure-turn action across the family using unchanged angular acceleration and speed. This is a controlled physical diagnostic, not a claim that the actor selected that action sequence.
diagnostic_family.turn_action: left in context0, right in context1
diagnostic_family.blackout: Actual all-zero RGB through the continued visual encoder

input_conditions.native_current: Native current spatial code, native saved goal snapshot
input_conditions.ordinary_current: In the PGC-trained network replace only the169 current PGC slots by ordinary-grid values at the identical position; preserve every saved goal slot. Start from exactly the same native-prepared recurrent states. In Grid this is an identity control.
input_conditions.interpretation: A fixed native PGC movement-direction cue can potentially pin a phase. Ordinary-current release is therefore required before rejecting an unforced ring from native-input phase collapse. Body heading and last movement direction remain separate variables. The saved goal code is unchanged in every condition.

primary_times_updates.primary_candidate: Reference at2s plus2s evolution, ending at the trained4s maximum gap

primary_measures: Full512-state geometry, closure/neighbor gaps/nonlocal separation, raw and initial h/c-RMS-scaled distances
Future full states projected to the fixed earlier dense curve, with phase coverage/order and no2D decoder used to define geometry
Targeted inward/outward2%-radius kicks projected off the local tangent; residual distance to the evolved unperturbed curve divided by actual initial distance, alongside actual tangent-length gain
Initial-heading readout fitted on even angles only; odd angles always held out. Report initial-angle and updated-body-heading errors, angular bias and concentration separately
Time-refit and time-centered readouts labelled information-only sensitivity analyses
Hidden-state, cell-state and actor-output expression of surviving heading differences
candidate_nomination: Within the trained horizon, nominate a condition for further spectral/causal tests only if both coordinate metrics retain at least5% of initial family radius; largest curve edge<=10%radius; p10 nonlocal separation>=5%radius; p90 future-to-fixed-curve residual<=5%radius; phase coverage>=80%; projected phase-map degree within0.1of1; reversed edges<=5%; radial gain<=0.5 and radial/tangent gain<=0.5. Frozen readout accuracy is a separate functional result and cannot by itself reject decoder-independent ring geometry.
secondary_extrapolation: Any5s or100s original-style assay is explicitly beyond the trained4s gap and cannot replace the primary within-horizon result.
reporting: Retain both contexts, both populations and native/released inputs regardless of outcome. This is a one-seed-per-population mechanistic pilot; make no population-level significance claim. Useful recurrent memory is assessed separately by the prespecified native-navigation blind/seen reset controls.
